title: Strettch Cloud
summary: A cloud platform that simplifies AI infrastructure management, enabling teams to launch, monitor, and scale faster.
objective: To push creative boundaries, delivering user-friendly and impactful designs that captivate audiences. Our focus is on aesthetics, usability, and innovation.
closing: From vision to reality, we forge designs that inspire and redefine the future of digital experiences.

sections.title: Cloud infrastructure shaped for product teams
sections.body: Strettch Cloud is a developer-focused cloud platform built to help organizations deploy and manage AI workloads more efficiently. The platform combines resource provisioning, workload management, monitoring, and cost tracking into a single experience, making cloud operations more accessible and easier to manage.

sections.title: Building cloud infrastructure that feels simple
sections.body: We noticed that engineering teams were spending too much time configuring infrastructure before they could start building products. Managing virtual machines, allocating computing resources, and monitoring costs often involved complex workflows and disconnected tools. We set out to create a cloud platform that would simplify these processes and help teams focus on innovation rather than infrastructure management.

sections.title: Making technical cloud operations easier to manage
sections.body: Many engineering teams faced challenges when setting up and maintaining cloud infrastructure. Provisioning resources often required lengthy configurations, infrastructure costs were difficult to track, and teams lacked visibility into workload performance. These challenges slowed development cycles and increased operational complexity.

sections.title: Understanding how teams deploy and manage infrastructure
sections.body:
We worked closely with engineers, technical leads, and product teams to understand their daily workflows. Through discussions, workflow reviews, and product feedback sessions, we discovered that users needed faster setup processes, clearer resource visibility, and simpler ways to manage cloud operations without sacrificing flexibility.

Key Insights
- Infrastructure setup consumed valuable development time.
- Resource allocation workflows were difficult to understand.
- Cost monitoring tools lacked transparency.
- Existing cloud platforms felt overwhelming for many teams.
- Users preferred guided experiences over technical configuration screens.

sections.title: A polished path from vision to release
sections.body: From vision to reality, we forge designs that inspire and redefine the future of digital experiences.

sections.title: A unified cloud management ecosystem
sections.body:
We designed a cloud platform that brings infrastructure management into a single, streamlined experience. The platform allows teams to provision resources, deploy workloads, monitor performance, and control spending through intuitive workflows and real-time insights.

The solution focused on simplifying complex cloud operations while maintaining the level of control required by engineering teams

title: Sinc Events
summary: A connected digital ecosystem that streamlines event discovery, management, and operations for organizers, teams, and attendees.
closing: Add the final case-study note here.

sections.title: Connecting Every Part of the Experience
sections.body: As Sinc continued to grow, different user groups needed better ways to interact with the platform. Event organizers required powerful management tools, attendees expected seamless experiences, and internal teams needed efficient operational workflows. We worked to create a unified ecosystem that connected all these experiences while maintaining consistency across products.

sections.title: One Ecosystem, Multiple Experiences
sections.body: Sinc is a digital platform designed to support event operations from planning and management to attendee engagement. The ecosystem serves organizers, internal teams, and end-users through a collection of connected products that work together to deliver a seamless experience.

sections.title: Disconnected Workflows
sections.body: Different user groups relied on separate tools and processes to manage events, track operations, and engage with attendees. This created inefficiencies, inconsistent experiences, and increased operational complexity.

sections.title: Understanding Every User Group
sections.body: We worked with organizers, internal stakeholders, and end-users to understand how they interacted with the platform. The research revealed a need for simpler workflows, clearer navigation, and stronger consistency across products.

sections.title: A Unified Product Ecosystem
sections.body: We redesigned key parts of the ecosystem to create a more connected experience across web and mobile platforms. The new approach improved usability, streamlined workflows, and established a stronger design foundation for future growth.

title: InternQuest
summary: A mobile platform that helps students discover internships, build networks, and access career opportunities more effectively.
closing: Add the final case-study note here.

sections.title: Bridging the Gap Between Talent and Opportunity
sections.body: We recognized that many students and recent graduates struggled to find meaningful internship opportunities and build professional connections early in their careers. Existing platforms often focused only on job listings and overlooked the broader journey of career development. We set out to create a platform that would help young professionals discover opportunities, connect with mentors, and confidently prepare for their future careers.

sections.title: A Career Companion for Emerging Professionals
sections.body: InternQuest is a mobile-first platform designed to support students and recent graduates throughout their professional journey. The platform combines internship discovery, networking, career development, and personalized guidance into a single experience.

sections.title: Limited Access to Career Opportunities
sections.body: Many students lacked access to relevant internships, professional networks, and career resources. The process of finding opportunities often felt fragmented, requiring users to navigate multiple platforms without clear guidance or support.

sections.title: Understanding Student Career Challenges
sections.body:
Our research focused on understanding how students search for internships, prepare for applications, and connect with professionals.

Key Findings
- Students struggled to discover relevant internship opportunities.
- Many lacked professional networks and industry connections.
- Career guidance resources were often difficult to access.
- Existing platforms focused on listings rather than long-term career growth.
- Users wanted a centralized platform that supported multiple career needs.

sections.title: Creating More Meaningful Career Journeys
sections.body: We believed that combining internship opportunities, professional networking, and personalized career support into one platform would help students make better career decisions and improve their chances of success.

sections.title: Students and Early-Career Professionals
sections.body:
The platform was designed primarily for:

- University students seeking internships.
- Recent graduates entering the job market.
- Young professionals exploring career opportunities.
- Mentors and industry professionals supporting emerging talent.


PERSONAS
The Career Explorer

A student looking for internship opportunities, career guidance, and ways to gain practical experience before graduation.

The Recent Graduate

A young professional searching for entry-level opportunities while building a professional network and personal brand.

The Mentor

An experienced professional interested in sharing knowledge, supporting students, and helping shape future talent.

title: MediHealth
summary: A telemedicine concept designed to help Rwandan patients access medical care remotely through low-bandwidth consultations and guided symptom reporting.
closing: Add the final case-study note here.

sections.title: Expanding Access to Healthcare
sections.body: We explored how telemedicine could improve access to healthcare in Rwanda, particularly for people living in areas with limited access to specialists. The challenge was to create an experience that worked across varying levels of connectivity, digital literacy, and device capabilities while maintaining trust between patients and healthcare providers.

sections.title: Healthcare Beyond Physical Clinics
sections.body: MediHealth is a telemedicine platform concept designed to connect patients and clinicians through remote consultations. The platform focuses on making healthcare more accessible by enabling patients to report symptoms, communicate with clinicians, and receive guidance without needing to travel long distances.

sections.title: Distance Creates Delays
sections.body: Many patients face barriers when seeking medical care, including long travel times, limited specialist availability, and overcrowded health facilities. These challenges can delay diagnosis and treatment, especially for people living outside major urban centers.
